concepts.name: 명각 · 균형
concepts.note: 기존 명각의 비례를 유지하고 은빛 면과 아래 시계선을 정돈했습니다.
concepts.direction: BALANCED REFINEMENT: The closest sibling to the reference. Keep broad classical capitals with the same confident A/S/T/E/L/L/A silhouette, medium stroke weight, calm horizontal baseline and carefully even optical spacing. Refine the silver surface into a satin engraved finish, less distressed and less shiny than the reference. The secondary clock is a single thin shallow semicircle directly below the word, open at the top, with six short sparse ticks and one small vertical stopped hand at the centre. Keep it quiet, delicate and symmetrical. No top ornament and no new emblem.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / logo-brand variation.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET AND IDENTITY REFERENCE: the user's selected ASTELLA wordmark called "Expedition Inscription". Produce one sibling variation of THIS APPROVED DESIGN, not a new unrelated logo.
Keep these family invariants: exactly ASTELLA, seven uppercase letters A S T E L L A in order; elegant classical high-contrast serif capitals; readable separate double L; open triangular A counters and a subtle sweep across their bars; pale satin silver/cool ivory faces with restrained lavender in the bevel shadows; shallow sculpted depth and restrained worn engraved grain. The large word is the hero and a thin, low-contrast stopped-clock construction beneath/behind the lower part is secondary. Keep the same overall quiet, serious, premium fantasy expedition mood and silver-violet Astella UI language.
Clean handcrafted lettering, not generic typed letters surrounded by random trinkets. No new canon, tagline, subtitle, Korean, numerals or extra text. The reference's painterly surface may be refined but don't turn it into glossy chrome, plastic or a glowing purple gem logo.
Output ONE self-contained complete horizontal wordmark on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, wide roughly 3:1 canvas, no clipping, preserve at least a little transparent safety margin on all sides. No forest, environment, panel, fake checkerboard, characters, UI screen or presentation grid. All seven letters and bottom clock must be completely visible. It will be placed at about 634px wide on a 1920px title screen, so keep a strong readable silhouette.
Avoid added crowns, wings, central jewels, crystal clusters, church arches, decorative leaves, flowers, multiple clock faces, excessive cogs, bronze/brass steampunk, particles and neon haze. Main text verbatim: "ASTELLA".

The secondary clock is a single thin shallow semicircle directly below the word, open at the top, with six short sparse ticks and one small vertical stopped hand at the centre. Keep it quiet, delicate and symmetrical. No top ornament and no new emblem.

concepts.name: 명각 · 장신
concepts.note: 세로로 길고 가는 글자에 여유로운 간격을 주고, 뒤쪽 시계는 희미하게 남겼습니다.
concepts.direction: TALL ELEGANT LETTERING: Within the same reference family, make the capitals noticeably more elongated vertically, about 20 percent taller and a little narrower, with refined thin hairlines and slender stems. Increase the visible gaps between letters for an airy ceremonial inscription, while remaining one readable word. Smooth matte silver faces, fine lavender edge reflections. A very faint large incomplete clock arc lies BEHIND THE LOWER QUARTER of the word, with only its lower sweep and four tiny ticks visible. No central jewel or hanging ornament, no exaggerated Gothic spikes, no tall clock above the letters.

concepts.name: 명각 · 조각
concepts.note: 획과 조각 깊이를 조금 키우고 무광 은색 재질로 묵직하게 다듬었습니다.
concepts.direction: DEEP CHISELED INSCRIPTION: Keep the same elegant Roman-serif skeleton, but give the main stems about 25 percent more body and visibly deeper, carefully hand-chiseled bevels. A serious carved silver monument rather than heavy bold block type: keep open counters, fine serif ends and clear spaces. Faces are matte pale silver with sparse tool marks and subtle violet shadow in recessed edges, not mirror metal. The clock remains a compact thin lower half-dial beneath the centre, narrower than the word, minimal shallow engraving, no pendant and no thick ornamental frame. Strong quiet legibility is the goal.

concepts.name: 명각 · 단절
concepts.note: 글자의 형태를 지키면서 얕은 시간의 균열과 끊어진 시계 호를 넣었습니다.
concepts.direction: STOPPED TIME / SUBTLE INTERRUPTIONS: Preserve the reference's graceful silver serif word and balanced classical proportions. Add just two or three fine controlled engraved fracture seams across parts of the T/E/L strokes, with narrow amethyst-dark recesses. Letters remain whole and readable: no missing pieces, gaps through the full letter, rubble or floating shards. Below, the clock is represented by two separated low silver arc segments with a deliberate small gap off-centre and a motionless slender hand. Slightly weathered satin silver, subtle historical gravitas. The result is restrained and architectural, not a shattered crystal logo.

concepts.name: 명각 · 태엽
concepts.note: 얇은 하단 시계 호의 양끝에 작은 태엽을 넣어 시간 장치를 강조했습니다.
concepts.direction: RESTRAINED MAINSPRING DETAIL: Keep the reference's large elegant classical silver capitals, their open counters and flat broad word silhouette. Retain a thin shallow clock arc underneath. At ONLY the two lower arc ends add very small flat coiled mainsprings integrated into the line, like precision silver watch engravings, no more than one tenth of the letter height each. A tiny central plain stopped pivot and a fine hand complete the lower mechanism. Clock detail occupies less than a quarter of total logo height and remains much quieter than the word. No upper clock, no border, no ornate baroque flourishes, no large gears. Pale brushed silver with restrained lavender shadows.
